{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor drones''' were [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based scanning devices. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] ordered sensor drones to be deployed throughout the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] to provide an early-warning screen against returning [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
